pending_question.question: Where does a thread's tenant come from for the visibility gate?
options_presented: Derive from the thread's runs (Recommended): tenant = submitted_by of the thread's latest run, the rule ensure_thread_visible already applies on submit and fork; no schema change, no pub field on Waypoint/ThreadSummary, no WaypointPort change; semver green at patch level, milestone stays v0.11.1; cost: GET /v1/threads needs a per-thread run lookup, run-less threads have no tenant

Record a tenant on the thread: tenant_id column on waypoints (no threads table exists) or a new threads table, plus a pub field on Waypoint and ThreadSummary and a WaypointPort change; exact and query-friendly but a public break on paladin-ai-core and paladin-ports: MIGRATION.md section 11.2 row, allowlist entry, milestone becomes v0.12.0
Derive now, record later: ship derive-from-runs in v0.11.1 and open a deferred idea to record the tenant in the next feature milestone

prior_decisions_carried: ADR-0054: tenant server-derived; RunReadScope {All, Tenant}; hidden equals missing (404 never 403); Admin bypass; one shared gate plus an OpenAPI-derived route matrix

Milestone open: A6 reserved literals rejected at config load; A7 boot warn! only, no backfill; a tenant column is a migration, not a feature; no new routes

codebase_facts: No threads table: a thread exists only as waypoints.thread_id and runs.thread_id
Waypoint (paladin-ai-core), ThreadSummary and WaypointPort (paladin-ports), JobRecord (paladin-web) are all-pub-field types without #[non_exhaustive]: adding a field or trait method is a public break
WaypointPort has 10+ implementors (sqlite, postgres, in_memory, retention, erased wrapper, parley adapter, chronicle, test doubles)
run_controller.rs has published_run_id_operations: the OpenAPI-derived route-matrix precedent to mirror for /v1/threads/{id}*
get_job ignores principal and agent id; JobStore keeps JobRecord {status, result, error} in an in-memory bounded map
build_run_api always calls with_engine_factory and attaches the Treasurer via with_treasurer; nothing asserts the pairing
AuthConfig::validate (src/config/agents.rs) is the config-load validation site; reserved literals per 40-REVIEW IN-01: open-access, unattributed as tenant/key names, anonymous as key name
RunScheduleRepositoryPort::list(limit, cursor) pages all schedules; RunSchedule.created_by: Option<RunAttribution>
